question: The Gross Domestic Product of a country is derived from the different sectors of the economy, namely ______.

options.text: agricultural sector, and the industrial sector only
agricultural sector, the industrial sector and the service sector

solution:
The correct answer is __**agricultural sector, the industrial sector and the service sector**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of a country is derived from the **agricultural sector, the industrial sector, and the service sector**.
 
• These sectors collectively contribute to the overall economic output of the country.
